component.name: Apache Hudi
component.description: Data lakehouse library that relies on the security posture of the underlying compute engine and storage environment in which it operates. In typical production environments, compute platforms such as Presto, Apache Spark, and Apache Flink run within isolated network zones (VPCs, VLANs, or on-premises subnets) with access restricted to authorized parties.

externalReferences.comment: Source security model document; this file is a structured translation of it.

threats.name: Unauthorized access to the compute and storage environment
threats.description: Apache Hudi is a library that relies on the security posture of the underlying compute engine and storage environment in which it operates; it does not itself enforce authentication or network access control. Protection against unauthorized connections is expected from the deployment environment: compute platforms run within isolated network zones with firewalls, access control lists, and routing policies preventing unauthorized parties from connecting.

controls.name: Deploy compute engines in isolated, access-controlled network zones
controls.description: Run the compute platforms embedding Hudi (Presto, Apache Spark, Apache Flink) within isolated network zones such as VPCs, VLANs, or on-premises subnets, with access restricted to authorized parties and network protections (firewalls, access control lists, routing policies) preventing unauthorized connections.
